title: Uri Navigation System
description: Fix all repo:// URIs to resolve correctly in the VS Code extension. Clicking URIs and using repo Navigate to command should navigate to the correct resource.
summary: Implemented comprehensive repo:// URI navigation system in VS Code extension. Extended parseUri regex to handle collection URIs (authority-only, no path). Rewrote navigateToUri to handle all 30+ URI types: repo, projects/project, bundles/bundle, folders/folder, files/file, sections/section, definitions/definition, tickets/ticket, goals/goal, drafts/draft, todos/todo, policies/policy, statutes/statute, contributors/contributor, commits/commit. Added TextDocumentContentProvider for repo:// scheme to enable URI resolution in VS Code. Extended parseUri test suite from 10 to 32 tests. Extended Navigation Commands test suite from 6 to 25 tests. All 158 tests passing.
